facilities.name: Humlebadet, Aspen
facilities.description: Bathing place by Aspen on or near the more demanding eastern route/variant, with seasonal toilet/kiosk/café, grill and waste baskets. May relate to the eastern/longer variant near Aspen; confirm against chosen main-line geometry before import. Dogs prohibited at Humlebadet during bathing season under Partille rules.

facilities.name: Torpet Freden cluster
facilities.description: Major Bokedalen facility cluster with two wind shelters, tent site, toilets, drinking-water claim, grill/fireplaces, seasonal waffle café and rentable croft/barn. Import as one cluster with child amenities, not many duplicate points. WST says water is available, but Friluftsfrämjandet rental information says the barn lacks running water/sewer/toilet and has an outdoor toilet on the yard; Check potable water with manager/on-site signs before marking reliable.

facilities.name: Lilla Ramsjön rastplats / bridge area
facilities.description: Rest/fireplace/picnic area by the Lilla/Stora Ramsjön crossing, with active trail-status warning: old suspension bridge is closed/collapsed and the newer bridge must be used. Bridge warning should be modeled as trail-status/access metadata in addition to facility record. Use only the newer bridge and follow current signs.
